displayPattern: Status LED: 3 short flash(es) then 1 long flash(es) (code 31)
meaning: Low (LPS) or high (HPS) pressure switch did not close or reopened.
causes: Restricted vent or improper vent sizing
Defective inducer motor or low inducer voltage
Restricted or blocked condensate drainage, or water in sagging vent pipe
Low inlet gas pressure (if LGPS used)
diySteps: Check that outdoor vent and intake terminations are clear
Technician: check vent sizing, inducer, pressure switches and tubing
Technician: check condensate drain and vent pipe slope
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if vent terminations are clear and the code repeats.
